trust.subtitle: How InstantGPA calculates, protects, and qualifies academic results.
trust.principles.title: Calculation principles
trust.principles.gpa: GPA is the sum of (credits × grade points), divided by total credits attempted.
trust.principles.cgpa: CGPA combines your previous quality points with this term's quality points, divided by combined credits.
trust.principles.weighted: Weighted scores multiply each component's score by its share of the total weight.
trust.principles.rounding: Every calculation keeps full precision internally; only the final displayed result is rounded, to 3 decimal places for GPA/CGPA.

trust.responsible.title: Responsible-use statement
trust.responsible.body: InstantGPA is a planning and estimation tool, not an official transcript or credential-evaluation service. Decisions about graduation, probation, scholarships, or admission should always be confirmed with the institution responsible for your official record.
